events.name: Bash
events.head: Check pass.py spec support and T-225 state
events.input: $ grep -n "spec" workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py | head -5; python3 -c "import json;t=[x for x in json.load(open('workshop-plan/tasks/tasks.json'))['tasks'] if x['id']=='T-225'][0];print(t['status'],'|',t.get('needs_from_owner',''),'|',t['recent_log'][-1]['note'][:300] if t.get('recent_log') else '')" 2>&1 | head -5
